requirement.description: The receive_messages method is returning a coroutine instead of an async iterator, causing TypeError: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method should return an AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]] that can be properly consumed with async for loops.

requirement.description: Context manager's __aexit__ method doesn't properly close transport connections, causing AssertionError: Expected 'close' to have been called once. Called 0 times.
requirement.contract: The __aexit__ method should ensure that transport is properly closed even when exceptions occur, and should call disconnect() on the transport.

requirement.description: The _stream_to_stdin method isn't correctly handling the closing of stdin stream in streaming mode, leading to connection issues.
requirement.contract: The _stream_to_stdin method should properly manage the stdin stream lifecycle, ensuring it's closed appropriately after sending messages.

requirement.description: The process_query method in InternalClient doesn't properly handle the streaming mode for async iterables, leading to connection issues.
requirement.contract: The process_query method should properly manage the transport lifecycle for async iterable prompts.

requirement.description: Missing proper handling of control protocol responses for interrupt functionality, causing assertion failures.
requirement.contract: The interrupt method should properly send control requests and handle responses, ensuring the transport can properly manage interruptions.
